speaker: N
text: His bag is on that train.
direction: Bright and up on 'His BAG', level to 'train'. One take with v3_n02 and v3_n03, best of 6-8, untagged first. Gate on the assembled hook (three pauses set to 0.15 s): 'not' starts by 2.70 s, 'laugh' starts by 4.50 s, no gap over 0.20 s; prefer 'finger' starting by 5.00 s; if no take passes, record again; never stretch.

note: The pause after this line may be 0.20 s (the deadpan's breath) on a take where 'not' still starts by 2.60 s.

speaker: N
direction: Low and flat, at the same speed as the first sentence, 1.05-1.20 s. The drop in pitch is the joke, not a slow-down. Untagged first; use [deadpan] only if it measures better (no whisper, no creak).
caption: He is not.
note: Cut 1 sits in the silence after this line, placed from the accepted take's real word times.

speaker: N
text: All he did was laugh... at a finger.

note: Cut 2 sits one frame before 'finger' (4.88 s on the plan), placed from the accepted take's real word times.

speaker: T
text: (a real belly laugh, about 2 s, no words)

speaker: D

The file holds three calls ('Signal... green! Speed... check! Doors... closed!'): cut only the span in v1_build_take_on_off_s and compare the transcript of that cut with expected_words, so 'Speed... check!' can never play.

speaker: T
direction: Mocking; a real laugh before and under the words; a rising end. Accept only if 'He's' is clear (the old 'Bro's' scored 0.56).

text: But that driver has a thousand people behind him.

speaker: N

speaker: D

speaker: N
direction: Low and clipped. Recorded as ONE take with v3_n10 ('Second stop. ... It stays.') and split in silence: never record a two-word narrator line alone.

speaker: T
direction: 'Stay.' low and fond, 'Be right back.' bright.
caption: STAY. / BE RIGHT BACK.

speaker: N
direction: The quietest, flattest narrator line in the film. Untagged first; [deadpan] only if it measures better.
caption: It stays.

speaker: T
direction: Proud, stiff, fake-deep, too loud. Never a put-on accent: listen to the reused take for this before it is placed; if it has one, record again. Check that its own beat is 0.35 s or more; if not, add silence, never squeeze.
caption: VENDING MACHINE... / CHECK!
note: The 2.78 s after it has no voice: 0.33 s pose hold, the 1.10 s wordless shot v3_p01 (the boy points, mouth shut), then 1.35 s (head turn, the 0.7 s look, the grin). Measured in the verify pass (ch_t04/t2.probe.json; this take was not in the v1 build, so its span is the probe's): the take's own beat is 0.24 s, under the 0.35 s floor of fact guard 5. The build adds 0.11 s of silence inside the beat (the line is then 1.97 s and the plan 65.23 s), or the lead takes the 0.11 s out of the 0.33 s pose hold. Never squeeze.

speaker: T
direction: Charmed, warm, no laugh tag. Test every word ('gets it' is an idiom; three stops in a row).
caption: THIS KID / GETS IT!

speaker: N
text: You see, his eyes looked right at it. His mind was on his phone.

caption: You see, / his eyes / looked right / at it. / His mind / was on / his phone.
note: The 1.45 s after it holds the phone's replay v3_r01 (it starts 0.30 s before the end of 'phone.' and ends 1.37 s after it), then 0.08 s.

speaker: T

speaker: N

speaker: N
text: For every six mistakes people made just looking... when they pointed and said it out loud: about one.
direction: Count evenly up to 'SIX', hang on 'looking...'; 'when they pointed and said it out loud' lighter and higher; 'about ONE' low, slow, landed. Record with v3_n12's words as the previous line so it follows on. Confirm the word 'six' by its length (0.25 s or more).
fallback_text: For every six mistakes people made just looking... point and say it out loud: about one.
caption: For every 6 / mistakes people made / just looking... / when they pointed / and said it / out loud: / about 1.
note: First clause 47.40-50.09 (measured 2.69 s in v1, the same words). The 1.00 s pause is the cutaway v3_p02. Second half 51.09-53.09, 0.30 s, 'about one.' 53.39-54.19. A splice with the v1 first clause (c08/t1) is the last resort only.

speaker: T

note: The 0.75 s after it: 0.40 s of quiet in the cab, the chime and the doors start (58.12 s), the cut to the platform (58.32 s), the doors seen sliding for 0.15 s before the driver's word.
